notes:
Read platform/lib/completion_predicate.py (the 12-condition reducer, ~1310 lines) and platform/lib/test_completion_predicate.py (the conformance/mutation-battery suite) in full, plus command-center/receipts/CC-0003.json end to end. The reducer's 12 conditions match COMPLETION-GATES.json's gate_a texts in order (1-12), NON_WAIVABLE={1,2,3,4,5,11,12} matches the spec's 'structural, never waivable' set, and Outcome.NOT_CHECKED is a first-class enum member distinct from SATISFIED/UNSATISFIED that is never folded into COMPLETE (verdict logic: any UNSATISFIED -> INCOMPLETE, else any NOT_CHECKED -> INDETERMINATE, else COMPLETE; both INCOMPLETE and INDETERMINATE fail is_complete). Ran the full pytest suite verbatim below: 65 passed, 0 failed, 0.84s. Verified independently (not by re-reading the receipt's claims) that: (a) the mutation battery's own both-states control (test_battery_rejects_a_noop_predicate) proves the battery itself can go red against a stub always-COMPLETE predicate, so the 12 green per-condition mutation tests are not vacuous; (b) the receipt's own reviewer field correctly declares verdict=NOT-REVIEWED/independent=false/state=BLOCKED rather than fabricating a PASS -- the implementer did not self-certify; (c) the cross-vendor comparison (vendor_identity.compare_vendors) resolves canonical identity rather than doing a naive string-inequality check, which the code comments (DEFECT D1) document was a real, previously-measured hole (alias pairs like anthropic/claude or trailing-space variants used to be accepted as 'cross-vendor'). I independently re-verified this defect is actually fixed rather than trusting the comment, by calling evaluate() directly with a reviewer vendor string 'Claude ' (trailing space, different case, alias of 'anthropic') against a produced_by.vendor of 'anthropic' under require_cross_vendor_review=True: condition 9 correctly returned UNSATISFIED with basis 'both resolve to vendor anthropic', not a false-positive cross-vendor pass. Verdict: PASS. This is a well-hardened total-function reducer with an honest not-yet-reviewed receipt; no load-bearing defect found.
